The overlap is more concrete than generic diplomatic courtesy, although the child expands the historical narrative around John Barry.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Dear Mr. President: May I, through you, express to the people of Fire the sincere respect and good wishes of the people of the United States upon this significant occasion.","parent_excerpt":"Dear Mr. President: On the occasion of Pakistan's establishment as a Republic within the Commonwealth, I send my greetings and best wishes, as well as those of the people of the United States, to you and through you to the people of Pakistan.","explanation":"Distinctive shared opening machinery: address to a president, identification of the occasion, transmission through him to his people, and wishes explicitly attributed to the people of the United States."},{"child_excerpt":"this bronze statue... will, we all hope, remain forever symbolic not only of the intermingling of our heritage but also of our common aspirations for liberty and justice","parent_excerpt":"The inauguration of Pakistan's constitution represents an important milestone in Pakistan's development as a modern, democratic state, responsive to the needs and aspirations of its people.","explanation":"Both move from ceremonial greetings to an interpretation of the event as a historical symbol of democratic or liberty-oriented aspirations."},{"child_excerpt":"a gift of his grateful countrymen to the people of the land from which he sprung","parent_excerpt":"Because of the close ties of friendship between our countries, the people of the United States are particularly happy to send expressions of good will on this memorable day","explanation":"Both conclude the substantive discussion by connecting the commemorative event to goodwill and enduring ties between the two peoples."}]}
